verses.text: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
lines: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint.
Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.text: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
lines: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked,
from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

verses.text: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
lines: who sharpen their tongue like a sword,
and aim their arrows, deadly words,

verses.text: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
lines: to shoot innocent men from ambushes.
They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

verses.text: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
lines: They encourage themselves in evil plans.
They talk about laying snares secretly.
They say, “Who will see them?”

verses.text: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
lines: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!”
Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

verses.text: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
lines: But God will shoot at them.
They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

verses.text: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
lines: Their own tongues shall ruin them.
All who see them will shake their heads.

verses.text: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
lines: All mankind shall be afraid.
They shall declare the work of God,
and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

verses.text: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
lines: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh,
and shall take refuge in him.
All the upright in heart shall praise him!
